name: Morpho Grove x Steakhouse + Steakhouse Turbo USDG vaults
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths checked

narrative.summary: Two more Steakhouse-curated Morpho vaults on this chain, found via the curator registry DefiLlama’s own dashboard actually reads from (not the per-protocol page, which 404s) - confirmed live before being added, not trusted from the registry file alone.
narrative.detail: Both vaults’ curator()/owner()/asset() (USDG) resolved live on two independent RPCs before either was tracked. Same chain-wide zero-delay setOwner/setCurator gap already disclosed for every other Morpho vault on this chain - not a new finding specific to these two.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# owner() on the contract: the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0xbeeff039907422219fb367e525954ddc092854d9","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x5416c47"]}'
# delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x5ff98717a18833de1a49e11b498866d6fa1c9296","data":"0x6a42b8f8"},"latest"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 88173313 and 88173639 of the chain

reproduce.note: this RPC cannot replay the block of the build (it ignores the block tag, or no longer serves old state): the call reproduces the current value, not the one of the build; compare the composite and lastUpdated with this page

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)
